working_title: Read department reports and verify a scoped CSV export
audience: Department administrators and authorized report viewers
purpose: Run date/group-scoped HTML reports, read source attribution and verify a real file export without scheduling deliveries.

scenes.capture_intent: Open normal Reports and locate each chosen report before navigating.
ordinary_read_only_actions: Use sidebar Reports
Capture multiple normal scroll positions if needed
scenes.result_to_record: Genuine catalog with visible chosen launchers.

scenes.capture_intent: Inspect existing Reports module switch and return without saving.
ordinary_read_only_actions: Open existing Module settings from department settings
Read Reports switch; do not toggle or Save
scenes.result_to_record: Actual unchanged displayed availability; distinguish separate permission.
limits: Do not claim module toggle is authorization revocation. Module settings is a broad save form.

scenes.capture_intent: Read HTML staffing counts, member rows and next scheduled change.
ordinary_read_only_actions: Use Staffing Report View Report
Scroll to one readable existing fictional member and scheduled column
scenes.result_to_record: Actual report generation time, counts and row values.
limits: No actual attendance, crew occupancy, device presence or changed staffing claim. No Personnel Report contact/PII capture.

scenes.capture_intent: Choose date range and All Groups with controls visible before Run.
ordinary_read_only_actions: Use normal date controls:2026-10-25 00:00 to2026-10-29 23:59 department-local
Retain All Groups
Capture prepared form
Run Report
scenes.result_to_record: Actual redirected HTML report for requested range.

scenes.capture_intent: Inspect actual total/type summaries and one complete existing call row.
ordinary_read_only_actions: Capture top totals and lower call list in separate full viewports
scenes.result_to_record: Visible date range, totals, open/closed distinction and actual row.
limits: Do not invent expected totals or treat blank on-scene/response times as zero. Source recorded statuses do not verify physical arrival.

scenes.capture_intent: Compare one existing group to All Groups and read the actual placement help.
required_visible_labels: Calls are placed in the group whose geofence contains the call's location. A call outside every geofence, or without a location, is placed in the group most of its dispatched units and personnel belong to. Choosing a group also includes the groups beneath it.
ordinary_read_only_actions: Return through normal report parameters
Choose actual existing Firehouse51 group
Run and capture actual group heading/result
scenes.result_to_record: Observed filtered count; explain descendants and attribution only as shown.
limits: Do not assert current group membership alone determines call placement or promise a particular count.

scenes.capture_intent: Show actual Call Unit Times date controls before running.
ordinary_read_only_actions: Return to Reporting
Use Call Unit Times launcher
Set same date range with normal picker
Run Report
scenes.result_to_record: Real HTML report for the requested range.

scenes.capture_intent: Read one complete already-recorded fictional call/unit row and its source label.
ordinary_read_only_actions: Locate existing own closed training call51011/FD51-2026-0003 if present
Capture actual matching number/title and Engine51 row; no data changes
scenes.result_to_record: Actual timestamps/blanks and literal linkage source.
limits: If that call has no row, retain honest state and use another existing fictional row. Do not synthesize status history.

scenes.capture_intent: Show Download CSV before an optional normal file download.
ordinary_read_only_actions: Capture actual Download CSV control
If supported normal browser download succeeds, retain original bytes/hash and read header/sample row
scenes.result_to_record: Actual CSV bytes verified against the displayed range/source data, or explicitly option-only.
limits: No PDF, spreadsheet upload, external submission or invented download success.

scenes.capture_intent: Differentiate current report viewing from an automatic delivery schedule.
ordinary_read_only_actions: Open own Profile Reporting through actual Report delivery launcher
Capture existing schedule list
Optionally open Add new scheduled report, inspect fields then Cancel without Save
limits: Saving creates active delivery work. Do not save/run/enable, send email or claim delivery. Omit this scene if identity/PII cannot be framed safely.

stop_conditions: Report/error/loading page must remain a gap
Browser download not supported: retain control-only evidence
Never create a report delivery schedule or use internal worker URL
